name: Brightcove CMS API Reference
description:
Reference for the Brightcove CMS API, used to access and manage your media library. To test API requests, you can use our [API Testing Tools](/getting-started/concepts-testing-tools-brightcove-apis.html). For permissions needed for OAuth credentials, see [API Operations](/oauth/guides/api-operations-client-credentials-requests.html). For information on authenticating API requests, see the [OAuth Overview](/oauth/getting-started/overview-oauth-api-v4.html).
